ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$4.38 (Ryde voucher) for the unexplained second deviation; note the RD-1 breach on the driver's record. No account flag (first upheld route dispute in 90 days).

segment_findings.reason: Rider consent to route around the jam near the start (driver 18:37:30, rider 'Sure, go ahead.' 18:38:10) covers this deviation, and LTA speed band 5 (0-9 km/h) on the replaced BUKIT TIMAH EXPRESSWAY stretch with a window (18:22:40-19:19:50) covering the segment gives reasonable cause under RD-4(a); exempt per RD-3/RD-4/RD-5.

≈4.15 km out-and-back loop from the Mandai Rd area (1.3900,103.7745 → 1.3871,103.7628 → back to 1.3904,103.7742) with no prior driver disclosure or rider consent (RD-5 fails), no traffic incident on the replaced route and no band-1/2 record to support the driver's 'GPS rerouting' claim (RD-4(a)/(b) fail; a band alone cannot exempt per G3). Unexempted off-route segment under RD-1, refunded per RD-2.
